request:
Defer node-specific validation until execution

## Problem

GitWeave currently performs whole-Graph preflight checks during Run initialization for requirements that only matter if a particular Node actually executes.

Examples include:

- requiring every Agent Node provider to already have a registered adapter
- requiring `--pr` whenever the Graph contains `sync_pr` or an existing-PR `merge_pr`

This means a Run can fail because of a Node that exists only in an unselected branch and would never execute.

That is speculative validation of possible future paths rather than validation of the path the Graph actually takes.

## Expected outcome

Defer Node-specific runtime requirements until that Node is actually executed.

Conceptually:

```text
Graph contains optional branch
  ↓
branch not selected
  → no Node-specific failure

branch selected
  ↓
execute Node
  ↓
check provider / PR input / other execution requirement
```

Keep static validation for the Graph structure itself, but do not reject a Run at initialization for runtime dependencies of Nodes that may never execute.

If an executed Node lacks its required adapter or PR input, fail clearly at that point.

## Context

The guiding principle is:

> Do not fail a Run for a hypothetical execution path.

Validate concrete runtime requirements when they become concrete.


User directive: GitWeave implements, creates a separate PR, reviews/fixes iteratively and merges only when clean. Stop on unsupported operations or permission/allowance limits and ask the user. No parent manual substitute is authorized.
